replies.author: Fouled
replies.body: It looks like the map would be somewhat stalematey with the size, shape and the placements of things. It would be hard to build a defense because the width of the pathway is large. Also, the map seems a bit flat. I would add some structures or anything that will boost the gameplay aspect of the map (for instance; maybe some soul sand?).
